categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
Do not bother asking moderators about a glitch, we'll have to see it in a run before we decide.

Runs require video (doesn't matter if its live or not) (twitch vods are fine)

categories.name: Single Player - SLA
categories.rules:
Save Load Abuse (SLA) rules: 
-No glitches requiring setup before starting (ex: movable portals)
- Scripting of any kind is banned

Console command rules:
- Fps_max modification is allowed but may only be set to values between 30 and 999.
an fps_max 0 value will not get your run banned if it is determined to not have given an advantage
- Anything protected by sv_cheats is not allowed
- Phys_timescale, kill, or other unnatural modifications are not allowed

Special allowed commands:
- cl_showpos 1 
- vm_debug
- cl_fov, but only between 45 and 140
- mat_ambient_light
- developer 1
- The SAR command(s) sar_hud_angles/position/velocity
- The SAR command ui_loadingscreen_transition_time 0

Timing:
- Timing starts when you gain control of Chell (crosshair appearing) and ends on final input before reaching the credits (shot to moon).
- Pause abuses must be timed. This can be done through livesplit's autosplitter or through SAR, NOT through demo timers.

If you are going to use a container ride save, note these things prior to submission of a run:
- Use either livesplit's built-in autosplitter or the SAR plugin. Demo timers will not work.
- If you are using livesplit's autosplitter, add 4 minutes and 41.13 seconds to the total time (either to start or after the run). 
- To use the SAR plugin to time container ride save, see the guide with demo timing on Livesplit
- It is recommended, but not required to use the save titled "Universal Container Ride" in Resources. This is especially the case if you plan to render your run and wish to include a container ride.

Proof:
All runs must be submitted with some sort of proof, sufficient evidence would be a game timer (demos are not sufficient). Livesplit or a like program must be used. You are allowed to remove loads but not pauses.

Same rules as Cooperative Game. Chapter runs within full game runs are allowed. Post demos only relevant to the chapter itself.

"bind [key] "-forward;-back;-moveleft;-moveright;-attack;-attack2;incrementvar in_forceuser 0 1 1" is allowed. The runner must only controller 1 player at a time.

categories.name: Solo Co-op
categories.rules:
This category uses the same rules as AMC, however coop progress does not have to be reset to run the category.

Below is a couple of binds that would be required/recommended to run the category:

BindToggle [KEY] in_forceuser, This makes it so you can switch between bots.

bind [key] "-forward;-back;-moveleft;-moveright;-attack;-attack2;incrementvar in_forceuser 0 1 1, If it appears your inputs are getting stuck or held down between switching bots.
